verses.text: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh skuchan Juan ix ak'an bautizar t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Judea. Hata' ix yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a heb' anima ix laj k'och t'ay.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a heb': --Na'ek he b'a yuj he chukal, yujto toxo ol wach' och Dios aj satcha'anh Yajalil, xchi winh.

Ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Isaías, ayokto ix stz'ib'ankan yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi icha tik: Ay jun t'a tzinan lu'um, cha'anh ol yal icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e yik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'o'an he b'eyb'al, yujto ol jawok Dios Kajal, xchama, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.
Ha winhaj Juan chi', ha xil nok' camello ayoch spichulok winh, haxo stzek'ul winh, ha nok' tz'u'um. Ha juntzanh nok' icha nok' yol sojoy schi winh, haxo nok' kaltakte'al yal chab' syuk'ej winh.
Ha heb' aj Jerusalén smasanil, sk'och heb' smaklej yab' t'a winh. Ay pax heb' t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judea yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil ha' niwan Jordán sk'ochi,
ix laj yalank'eta smul heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb' yuj winh t'a ha' Jordán chi'.

Tzijtum heb' fariseo yet' heb' saduceo ix laj k'och b'aj wan yak'an bautizar winh chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha hex tik, te jelan hex t'a chukal icha nok' chan. ¿Mach ix halan t'ayex to syal he kolanel he b'a t'a jun niwan yahelal ol jawok?
Tato tze na he b'a yuj he mul, yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'a yik scheklajeli to ix he na he b'a.

Manh heyal icha tik: Malaj pena, yinhtil honh kan winhaj Abraham. Yuj chi' malaj tas ol jawok t'a kib'anh, manh xe chiok. Yujto ha hin swal t'ayex, tato snib'ej Dios, syal yoch juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik yinhtilalok winhaj Abraham chi' he k'exulok.

Ha jun yahelal ol jawok chi', lajan icha junok winh winak lista yaj yet' sch'akab' t'a yich juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Jantaknhej te' chuklaj sat syak'a', ol laj ch'akjokel te'. Ol syumankanb'at te' winh t'a yol k'ak'.

Ha hin tik, t'a wal yel tzex wak' bautizar t'a ha ha', yik chekel to ix he na he b'a. Palta ay wal junxo tzak'an sjawi wu'uj. Ha ol ak'an Yespíritu Dios t'ayex, mato ha k'ak' ol yak' t'ayex. Icha to ol hex ak'jok bautizar yuj. Ha jun ol jawok chi', yelxo wal niwan yelk'och t'a wichanh. Manh hin mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej swik'el xanhab'.

Ha jun chi', lajan icha junok winh sluchank'e wa'an strigo yet' sluchlab', yik tz'el smatz'il ixim. Smesanxik'e wa'an t'a stek'lab'. Sik'anxib'at ixim trigo chi' t'a yet'tal. Haxo yok ixim chi', snhustz'a t'a yol jun k'ak' malaj b'ak'inh stupi, xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', spetoj Jesús t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix k'och t'a ha' niwan Jordán, b'aj ayek' winhaj Juan, yik syak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a.

Ha t'a sb'ab'elal max yal-laj sk'o'ol winhaj Juan chi' syak' bautizar Jesús. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a Jesús chi': --Smoj ha hin tzin ak' bautizar, yuj chi' manh smojok ha hin tzach wak' bautizar, xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Yowalil ol ha k'ulej jun tik yujto smoj sko k'anab'ajej jantaknhej tas syal Dios, xchi t'a winh. Ichato chi', ix cha'an sk'o'ol winhaj Juan chi'.
Haxo yik ix lajwi yak'ji bautizar Jesús, ix k'exta t'a yol ha'. Haxo t'a jun rato chi', ix jakwi satcha'anh. Ix yilan yemul Yespíritu Dios t'a yib'anh, icha junok nok' paramuch.
Haxo ix yab'an heb', ay jun ix lolonemta t'a satcha'anh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Haton jun tik, Wuninal. Te xajanab'il wu'uj. Tzin tzalaj wal yet'ok, xchi.
